description: This file contains the implementation of item variant management in an ERP system, including creation, validation, and attribute handling for item variants.

classes.name: ItemVariantExistsError
classes.description: Custom validation error for existing item variants.

classes.name: InvalidItemAttributeValueError
classes.description: Custom validation error for invalid item attribute values.

classes.name: ItemTemplateCannotHaveStock
classes.description: Custom validation error related to item stock constraints.

methods.name: get_variant
methods.description: Validates attributes and finds an exact matching item variant based on template and attribute args.

methods.name: make_variant_based_on_manufacturer
methods.description: Creates a new item variant based on manufacturer and manufacturer part number.

methods.name: validate_item_variant_attributes
methods.description: Validates item attributes and their values for a given item.

methods.name: validate_is_incremental
methods.description: Checks if a numeric attribute value is within range and increments.

methods.name: validate_item_attribute_value
methods.description: Validates if an attribute value is valid for an item.

methods.name: get_attribute_values
methods.description: Retrieves attribute values and numeric attribute ranges for an item.

methods.name: find_variant
methods.description: Finds a variant matching given attribute arguments.

methods.name: create_variant
methods.description: Creates a new item variant with specified attribute arguments.

methods.name: enqueue_multiple_variant_creation
methods.description: Enqueues creation of multiple variants based on attribute combinations.

methods.name: create_multiple_variants
methods.description: Creates multiple item variants from attribute combinations.

methods.name: generate_keyed_value_combinations
methods.description: Generates all combinations of attribute values for variant creation.

methods.name: copy_attributes_to_variant
methods.description: Copies relevant attributes from a template item to a variant.

methods.name: make_variant_item_code
methods.description: Generates item code and name for a variant based on template and attributes.

methods.name: create_variant_doc_for_quick_entry
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a variant document for quick entry, based on template and args.
